clue.text: See 17
Gay pub in Brown Shirts' photo

parts.note: the Brownshirts were the SA, the Nazi Sturmabteilung

indicators.note: the pub abbreviation is placed inside the other pieces, as the clue's in directs

parts.note: pic is short for picture or photo
PH is the map abbreviation for public house

explanation.surface: A gay bar appears in a photograph of Nazi stormtroopers.
explanation.walkthrough: The SA were the Nazi stormtroopers, nicknamed Brownshirts for their uniforms.
explanation.definitionFit: Sappho of Lesbos wrote of love between women, so the adjective means lesbian or, loosely, gay.

clue.text: 29 festival doesn't start

indicators.note: the festival word loses its opening letter, since it does not start

parts.note: Easter is a Christian festival

explanation.surface: Some flower festival fails to get under way.
explanation.definitionFit: An aster is a daisy-like garden plant grown for its blooms, an example of a flower.

clue.text: Yarn in which neo-Nazi infiltrates Negro organisation

indicators.note: one set of letters gets inside the other, as an infiltrator does
the letters of the word before are organised, put in a new order
neo means new, so the following word's letters are made new, rearranged

explanation.surface: A political extremist worms his way into a civil rights group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neo' (new) rearranges the letters of Nazi; 'organisation' rearranges Negro; 'infiltrates' puts the first scramble inside the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Organzine is a strong silk thread used as the warp in weaving, a kind of yarn.

clue.text: Tea otherwise consumed in 6 for 29s

indicators.note: the tea word swallows the other word, so it is placed inside

parts.note: cha is slang for tea
else means otherwise

explanation.surface: Tea is drunk at a venue for a flower show.
explanation.walkthrough: 6 is SHOWPLACE and 29 FLOWER: the Chelsea Flower Show is a famous annual event in London.
explanation.definitionFit: The Chelsea Flower Show makes this London district a celebrated show venue for blooms.

clue.text: Vegetable containing a drug results in farcical performance

indicators.note: the vegetable holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: chard is a leafy vegetable
E is short for ecstasy

explanation.surface: Eating a doped vegetable leads to a ridiculous show.
explanation.definitionFit: A charade is an absurd pretence, a piece of play-acting that fools nobody.

clue.text: Venerable character of 29-bearer

definitions.meaning: a respected senior person in a community
the ... tree bears elderflowers; 29 is FLOWER

explanation.surface: The respected elder of a flower-carrying procession.
explanation.definitionFit: An elder is a senior respected figure, and also a shrub whose white blossoms make cordial.

clue.text: Retail outlet stocking occidental fabric in the gallery

indicators.note: a shop stocks goods, so it holds the next piece inside

parts.note: a shop is a retail outlet
W for west; occidental means western
lace is a delicate fabric

explanation.surface: A shop sells western cloth to an art gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: A showplace is a site displayed to visitors for its beauty, much as a gallery exhibits works.

clue.text: Compensation when noon strikes?

definitions.meaning: making up for a wrong done
at twelve noon the morning, a.m., comes to an end

explanation.surface: Being paid back the moment the clock hits twelve.
explanation.definitionFit: To make amends is to give recompense for an injury, so amends means compensation.

clue.text: One question taken by a European sole

indicators.note: the first pieces are taken in by the outer ones

parts.note: un is French for a
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A single query is answered by a lone European.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unique is one of a kind, the sole example of its sort.

clue.text: Pop label on one going to a part of South America

parts.note: pa is a familiar word for father, like pop
a tag is a label
taken as written
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Dad attaches a tag to someone heading for South America.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'a' before the definition supplies a letter rather than linking.
explanation.definitionFit: Patagonia is the region at the southern tip of South America.

clue.text: Pass round surfeit from current director

indicators.note: the first word goes round the second

parts.note: to pass away is to die
an OD, an overdose, is a surfeit of a drug

explanation.surface: Going past an excess supplied by the current boss.
explanation.definitionFit: A diode lets electric current flow only one way, so it directs the current.

clue.text: Idol given name of bird

parts.note: an idol is a hero

explanation.surface: A hero is named after a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The heron is a long-legged wading bird.

clue.text: As misinformed about monarch as a cat or dog, say

parts.note: qua is Latin for as, in the capacity of

indicators.note: the misinformed word goes about the monarch

parts.note: duped means fooled, misinformed
R is for rex or regina

explanation.surface: Being as misled about the king as a family pet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As' looks like a link word but is Latin qua, as in 'qua artist'.
explanation.definitionFit: Cats and dogs are four-footed animals, examples of four-legged creatures.

clue.text: Turn over or wear it, if appropriate?

definitions.meaning: of a boat, to overturn in the water
an echo of the saying if the cap fits, wear it: the hat measurement suits

explanation.surface: Flip a boat, or put on headgear if it fits.
explanation.definitionFit: To capsize is to overturn, and cap size is the measure that decides whether a hat fits.

clue.text: Face down platforms in private

indicators.note: the platforms are put inside the abbreviation for private

parts.note: Pte is the army abbreviation for private
rostra are speakers' platforms

explanation.surface: A soldier lies face down behind the stands.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying prostrate means stretched out on the ground with face downward.

clue.text: Lasting impression made by English butter

parts.note: a ram is something that butts

explanation.surface: An English butter leaves a lasting impression.
explanation.definitionFit: An engram is the trace a memory leaves in the brain, a lasting impression.

clue.text: Fixative carrying ammunition for 29-bearer

indicators.note: the fixative holds the ammunition inside it

parts.note: gel fixes hair in place
rounds are bullets or shells

explanation.surface: Hair gel loaded with bullets is used for a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Groundsel is a common weed that bears small yellow blooms.

clue.text: 29's shore soon far off

indicators.note: off says the preceding words have gone bad, mixed up

explanation.surface: The flower's coast soon becomes distant.
explanation.walkthrough: 29 is FLOWER and 's is 'is'. ROSE OF SHARON is a name given to several flowering shrubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Rose of Sharon is a shrub such as hypericum or hibiscus, grown for its blooms.

clue.text: Half-caught fish bursting into 29

indicators.note: bursting breaks the letters apart into a new order
only the front half of the next word is used

explanation.surface: A half-hooked fish explodes into bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: CAU, the first half of CAUGHT, joins FISH and the seven letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: The fuchsia is a shrub with drooping pink and purple blooms.

clue.text: 12 1s in heraldic 29

indicators.note: the number word goes inside the heraldic flower

parts.note: lis is the fleur-de-lis, the lily of heraldry
the figure 1 read as one, with 's: one's

explanation.surface: Quadrupeds' ones placed among heraldic flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: A lioness is a female lion, a four-footed beast.

clue.text: Like a 12 29 given direction

parts.note: a lupin is a flower
E for east, a compass direction

explanation.surface: A quadruped-like flower is pointed eastward.
explanation.definitionFit: Lupine means wolf-like, and a wolf is a four-legged animal.

clue.text: Famous artists upset about famous marksman

indicators.note: the reversed artists go about the marksman
in a down clue, upset turns the word upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: RAs are Royal Academicians
William Tell shot the apple off his son's head

explanation.surface: Disturbed painters circle a legendary archer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns the artists over (to SAR), which suits a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Stellar means outstanding, of star quality, as a celebrity is.

clue.text: Honour student with American dagger

parts.note: the OBE is a British honour
L for learner

explanation.surface: A decorated student with an American knife.
explanation.definitionFit: An obelus is the printer's dagger mark used to flag a footnote.

clue.text: Oil dealers about to speak to copper 29

indicators.note: the oil company goes about the other pieces

parts.note: BP is a major oil company
to utter is to speak
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: Oil traders are about to talk to a policeman about a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: The buttercup is a meadow plant with shiny yellow blooms.

clue.text: Hurt in alien country

indicators.note: the hurt word sits inside the alien

parts.note: ET, the film's extraterrestrial
gyp is British slang for pain, as in my back is giving me gyp

explanation.surface: Injured inside a foreign land.
explanation.definitionFit: Egypt is a country in north-east Africa.

clue.text: Returned, somewhat disconcertingly, to the compound

indicators.note: returned means the letters are read backwards
somewhat means only part of the word is used

explanation.surface: Came back, rather disturbingly, to the walled enclosure.
explanation.walkthrough: ERTIN is taken from disconcERTINgly and turned back.
explanation.definitionFit: Nitre is potassium nitrate, a chemical compound used in gunpowder.

clue.text: Cast reportedly finished in America

indicators.note: reportedly signals that the word is spoken

parts.note: thru is US for through, meaning finished

explanation.surface: A theatre cast is said to have finished in the States.
explanation.definitionFit: Threw is the past tense of throw, which also means cast.

clue.text: Verdant Irish 29, as they say in France?

indicators.note: a French speaker would pronounce the word's first vowel as ee

parts.note: the Liffey is the river through Dublin: 29 read as flow-er, a river

explanation.surface: A green Irish bloom, as the French put it.
explanation.walkthrough: 29 is FLOWER, read as 'something that flows', a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Leafy means covered in foliage, green and verdant.

clue.text: Evil wind blowing head off and turning left

parts.note: sin is evil

indicators.note: the wind loses its first letter

parts.note: the mistral is a cold wind in southern France

explanation.surface: A wicked gale loses its top and veers left.
explanation.definitionFit: Sinistral means to the left, used of shells that coil leftward.

clue.text: Ranges of 13-d crafts with cargo of edible fungus

indicators.note: 13 is CAPSIZE, so capsized: turned over, and read backwards
the crafts hold the fungus inside like a cargo

parts.note: arts are crafts
a cep is an edible mushroom

explanation.surface: Boats carrying mushrooms are capsized over stretches of water.
explanation.walkthrough: 13 is CAPSIZE, so '13-d' reads as capsized, a turnover signal; the fungus sits inside the crafts and the whole is read upside down.
explanation.definitionFit: Spectra are ranges, as in a spectrum of opinions.

clue.text: Concerning 12 sent back by paragon

indicators.note: the pieces are sent back, read in reverse

parts.note: re means concerning
12 is QUADRUPED, here a wolf

explanation.surface: Something about a beast sent away by the best.
explanation.definitionFit: The flower of something is its finest part or paragon, as in the flower of chivalry.
